component_commits.summary: Retain applied PX4 parameter evidence and bind the P5 baseline to the server-created baseline Candidate identity.
Derive terminal P5 Job evidence from authenticated ORM state, accepted-attempt receipts, and byte-verified artifacts, then expose one read-only authenticated route.
Advance the P5 campaign one bounded action at a time through immutable checkpoints and forbid automatic POST replay after an unobserved dispatch.

properties: The authenticated server derives the baseline Candidate and ten Trial identities from ORM state; the desktop cannot submit these identities or verdicts.
Every completed Trial requires one accepted attempt, sealed artifact receipts, and byte re-verification for telemetry, scenario request/readback, PX4 parameter input/readback, and metrics.
The server validates exact scenario-effect application, exact PX4 parameter context and numeric values, and retains crash, timeout, instability, failure, cancelled, and indeterminate states.
The bridge maps server Trial rows to preregistered Trial identities by exact seed and scenario contract, never by random database UUID or response order.
The read-only route returns no storage paths, access tokens, API keys, passwords, raw prompts, raw chats, or provider request identifiers.
One invocation performs at most one external action: one Job create, one terminal evidence read, or no-op closed reporting; it never sleeps or polls internally.
dispatch_attempted is durably checkpointed before the create call, while job_observed time is sampled only after the create response returns.
A crash or exception after the durable dispatch reservation but before Job observation cannot automatically replay POST and requires manual read-only reconciliation.
A repeatable not-ready GET writes no checkpoint, while a verified terminal snapshot appends exactly one terminal checkpoint.
New dispatch requires the exact unexpired RED authorization; an already running Job may still be read and closed after authorization expiry so consumed work is not lost.
A complete six-scenario campaign produces exactly eighteen append-only checkpoints: dispatch attempted, Job observed, and terminal observed for each scenario.
